name: Fruit Skewer
author: Addicting Games
description: Fruit Skewer is a free mobile game. Go bananas with Fruit Skewer, the ultimate in fruit-themed match-three games that will have you skewering fruit like a pro! In this addictive game, your task is simple - align three or more pieces of fruit on your wooden skewer in order to clear them from the descending grid. But don't be fooled by the simplicity of the gameplay - as you progress through the levels, you'll encounter increasingly difficult challenges that will test your matching skills to the limit! While you must match at least three, you can technically fit as many pieces as will fit on your skewer. You can also Grab fruit that doesn't match and strategize your plays.
